remarks: Welcome to this stunning condominium rental located in the charming Cove district of Stamford, CT, a haven for lovers of comfort, convenience, and contemporary living. Set in a flourishing neighborhood, this property is perfect for anyone seeking a relaxed, convenient lifestyle. It boasts an open floor plan, bathed in natural light from its large windows. The hardwood flooring, combined with new lighting fixtures, captures a sense of modern sophistication. The updated kitchen, stainless appliances, and contemporary paint color scheme add a modern feel to a classic community. This one-bedroom, one-bathroom unit comes with a generous 796 square feet of living space. And yes, your pet is welcome too! One dedicated parking spot. In addition, the rent takes away the hassle of water and trash services, and yard maintenance, providing more time to enjoy the comforts of your home. Rental Application/References and Credit Score of 700+ a must. As for its location, it is nothing short of fantastic. Close to everything Downtown Stamford offers from great restaurants and shopping and fantastic parks like Cove Island and Cummings Park and nearby Chelsea Piers punctuating your life with refreshing greenspaces and a world-renowned fitness destination. Laundry and a storage space downstairs included. Experience this unique blend of comfort, style, and convenience today. Imagine the possibility of making this delightful property your new home!
